title: Actions related to transmission of RRCSystemInfoRequest message

entities.name: System Information Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests required system information messages from the network.

entities.name: RRCSystemInfoRequest Message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to request system information from the network.

entities.name: requested-SI-List
entities.description: Information element indicating SI messages required for normal cell operation when si-BroadcastStatus is notBroadcasting.

entities.name: requestedPosSI-List
entities.description: Information element indicating SI messages required for positioning operations when posSI-BroadcastStatus is notBroadcasting.

entities.name: Procedure triggered for required SI messages other than positioning
entities.description: Condition when UE requests SI messages for normal cell operation.

entities.name: Procedure triggered for required SI messages for positioning
entities.description: Condition when UE requests SI messages specifically for positioning operations.

entities.name: si-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting
entities.description: Property indicating that the required SI message is not currently being broadcast by the network.

entities.name: posSI-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting
entities.description: Property indicating that the required positioning SI message is not currently being broadcast by the network.

relations.description: The system information request procedure includes transmission of RRCSystemInfoRequest message.
RRCSystemInfoRequest message contains requested-SI-List IE when requesting normal SI.
RRCSystemInfoRequest message contains requestedPosSI-List IE when requesting positioning SI.
Condition for normal SI request guards the inclusion of requested-SI-List IE.
Condition for positioning SI request guards the inclusion of requestedPosSI-List IE.
requested-SI-List is only set for SI messages with si-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting.
requestedPosSI-List is only set for positioning SI messages with posSI-BroadcastStatus set to notBroadcasting.
